My suggestions is you guys need to come to the appointment as they schedule. 
The more documents you will bring it's better make copies and backup files for everything. 
Make list of questions for the next visit. And if something not clear Ask so you know. Bring all the necessary documents and pictures make check list so this is going to happen for the next 5 years. Try to be accurate with the documents with recommendations from family friends etc. 
Any way good luck with that
